ambiguities_and_deviations: Population Riemannian means use all fitting trials (trial weighting), not a mean of subject means.

Each stage consumes the preceding released signals. SCW's fixed tangent reference is the pooled Riemannian mean of Stage-1 fitting covariances; the text also permits interpreting Cbar as the original Stage-1 target. No choice is reselected on S2.
Defense covariance follows the explicit uncentered XX.T/t + 1e-6 I formula, in the BNCI MAT microvolt units. No demeaning, OAS or trace normalization in the defense.
Recolouring uses regularized source and target Cholesky factors. Thus empirical output covariance differs from the target by the transported 1e-6 ridge.

SCW scatter is centered sample covariance (ddof=1) + 1e-4 I; shrinkage 0.1 is applied AFTER this ridge iff subject n<=d; eigenfloor 1e-8 times maximum. The map acts on z, NOT z minus a subject mean, as equation 5 states.
BCI window chosen as cue+[0,4) seconds (1000 samples), consistent with Appendix C and Appendix F's imagery window; main-protocol onset is not explicitly specified.

Fifth-order 8-30 Hz Butterworth SOS zero-phase filtering is per extracted epoch with scipy default odd padding; fifth order is specified in Section 4, but padding and application boundaries are unspecified. BCA repeats the same filter on Stage-2 output and adds its untouched residual.
All four MI classes and official artifact-flagged trials are retained to match 288 trials/session. Nonfinite or incomplete epochs are rejected and counted.

CSP details incomplete: one-versus-rest identities, uncentered trace-normalized trial covariance, arithmetic class means, four smallest and four largest generalized eigenvectors per identity, log normalized projected variance; no additional subbands or feature scaling. RBF SVC and SVD LDA use sklearn defaults.

XDAWN uses one fixed filter per identity, OAS for both evoked filters and augmented covariance, applyfilters=True, fixed Riemannian tangent space and default RBF SVC. Unlike the paper's oracle maximum over 1/2/4/8, no evaluation-session selection is performed; this resource-limited result is NOT its oracle reproduction.
Reverse S2->S1 swaps only attacker train/test; the defense remains fitted on S1.

Aggregation uses nonoverlapping consecutive groups within subject/session/run; remainders are dropped, never crosses halves. Single-trial-trained classifiers receive mean feature vectors; nearest-template mean tangent is also reported. This differs from Appendix H random subsets and does not retrain classifiers for k.

Mechanism uses OAS covariances and a separate S1-fitted tangent reference per condition: mean pairwise Euclidean subject-centroid distance and mean within-subject Euclidean distance, equally weighted subjects. The paper does not fully define these summaries.
BEAT logistic/RBF-SVM/MLP reuse configs/exp_b.yaml unchanged, on attacker-training-fitted OAS tangent features; one deterministic seed 42, not Experiment B's five-seed ensemble.

Enrolment curves use the first n retained trials per participant in recording order within the attacker-training half, including when halves are reversed. The defense stays fitted on all S1; the attacker's tangent reference/scaling/classifiers are refitted using only these n labelled trials. Test groups are unchanged across n.

For n<inner_folds, BEAT RBF-SVM and MLP are not evaluable under the requested shared fit_attackers eligibility rule (MLP itself has no inner search). Fixed-C logistic regression is fitted separately with identical BEAT pipeline parameters at tiny n. No CV reduction, oversampling or hyperparameter fallback. All-enrolment cells reuse the identical original post-deployment fits and predictions.

Run-bootstrap intervals are conditional on fitted attackers, 500 resamples, and are descriptive rather than confirmatory; intervals are unavailable if any subject has fewer than two test recording units. Direction averages are unweighted. Paired signs are exhaustive for nine BCI identities and Monte Carlo (10000 draws, plus-one correction) for Lee2019 to avoid enumerating 2^54 signs.

Lee2019 uses pre-existing causal 8-30 Hz, cue+[1,4) reduced epochs, unlike the paper's zero-phase four-second preprocessing; train/test phases become two recording units. It cannot reconstruct missing samples or undo filtering. Session 2 requires a separately sealed plan; no Lee2019 data are needed for synthetic tests.
SPDNet-ID and MI utility decoders are not run. The strongest implemented attacker is not the paper's five-attacker worst, and identity failure alone is not anonymity.

threat_model_interpretation: Results are threat-model dependent. The paper's transform targets cross-session linkage when the attacker has reference-session labels only. The post-deployment audit gives the evaluator additional labelled deployment-session data; its enrolment curve measures how much of that additional access is needed. Strong identification in this scenario does not show that the paper's reference-session results are wrong or contradict its stated threat model. The 2a results are exploratory and concern a 9-person closed set, not a universal anonymity or utility assessment.
